svg.text: Landmark monuments for the scene points (world-layout §2, §2A, §9) · night look · each panel at its own scale, 1.7 m figure and scale bar in every panel · round 1
Game rules applied: statues veiled and faceless, no eyes on any creature, crosses become stars, animal heads become scrolls or lotus buds, nothing modern.
bridge end at the crag foot (≈ +250, +330) · leaning rose pylons, gold interlace crest
62 m pylons (66 m with star), 72 m across the plinths; 10 m gap at the crest; 6 m statues.
U398 leaning A-frame pylons with stepped slabs and notched caps; U134/U136 gold interlace crest; U60 pierced
roundel band; U379 gate statues with halo.
Blender mesh, one pylon mirrored; slabs share a rose-marble trim sheet + gold inlay emissive mask; crest as a
low-poly tube mesh; ~4k tris total. Statues instanced.
Temple Hill avenue (and ruined copies in the Ruin Meadows) · white marble, deep-rose soffits, gold suns
28 m wide, 24 m to the attic, 29.3 m to the star; central arch 9 × 14 m, side arches 3.6 × 7 m; 4.6 m deep.
U386 white arches with red soffits, gold sun reliefs, faceted gold impost blocks and star lantern; U387 red-banded arch
+ sun banners; U255 ribbon banners; U364 paired fluted columns.
Blender mesh baked to a light model (AO + light bake in vertex colour); gold as emissive-tinted metal; banners as alpha
cards with cloth sway shader. Ruin variant = same mesh with broken attic.
Lagoon City quay (obelisk) · avenue and courtyard (column)
Obelisk 46 m (48 m with winged star), 14 m dais; column 20.6 m on a 5.2 m stepped
U151 white spire with scale bulb, gold collar and beam on a stepped dais; U398 obelisk;
U85 crystal obelisk glow; U127 stepped-plinth monument; U139 column-statue avenue; U81
Obelisk: lathe/extrude mesh + beam as additive cone shader. Column: lathe mesh,
instanced along the avenue (12×) with the veiled statue as a shared mesh.
castle forecourt plaza at the foot of the grand stair · gold rings round a swirling water core
28.6 m tall (sphere Ø 13 m, centre at 18.5 m); platform 28 m across the flats on a Ø 34 m pool.
U360 golden armillary + orrery arms on a stepped gold plinth with banners and lamp posts; U380 armillary with swirling water core, teal
crystal plinth, arrow-tipped rings; U248 hanging gyroscope; U250 orb on pedestal.
Rings: Blender torus meshes, slow rotation animated in three.js; core = sphere with scrolling noise shader + point light; tiers: low-poly
Lagoon City campo and Storybook square
45 m to the star, 8.6 m base square, 7 m shaft.
U360 clock tower with gold pilasters, blue clock and pendulum drops; U310
glowing blue clock; U54 brick clock tower; U233 clock over an arch; U396
Blender mesh baked to a light model; clock face = emissive texture with
rotating hand meshes; belfry glow = emissive card.
Red Canyon bazaar entrance · sandstone, polychrome voussoirs, gold domes
Gate block 17.4 × 16 m, opening 6.2 × 9.5 m; towers 5.6 m wide, 22 m with domes; 28.6 m overall.
U292 horseshoe arches, hex lattice, twisted columns, drapes, brass lanterns; U276 gold-domed pavilion with
stepped crenellation; U221 horseshoe arches in the rose canyon; U275 gold dome caps; U278 Mughal gate.
Blender mesh baked; lattice as alpha-cutout cards with warm emissive behind; voussoirs vertex-coloured;
Lantern River market entrance and bridge ends · red lacquer, plum tiles, rows of lanterns
22 m wide over the roofs, 14 m to the ridge pearl; centre bay 7 m clear, 7.5 m to the beam.
U317 huge red gate with rows of glowing lanterns along beams and stacked on posts; U323 red gate and dark tiled roofs; U50
lantern glow; U68 red lacquer and stone bases.
Blender mesh baked; lanterns instanced (≈40) with emissive + sway in vertex shader; roof tiles as normal map on a curved
Lantern River waterfall shrine (torii) · Glowwood clearing and Long Bridge approach (waygate)
Torii 9.3 m tall, 11.4 m beam; stone lanterns 2.2 m. Waygate 10 m to the crest, 4.6 m wide on a Ø
U68 vermilion torii before a waterfall, stone lanterns; U59 torii on an overlook; U09 shrine
torii; U134 / U136 twin flared monoliths with gold-jade knot crest on a ring dais.
Torii: 10-box Blender mesh, vertex colour. Waygate: mesh + emissive inlay; dais ring = emissive
close-ups of the parts the build thread will model or bake
Ornament reliefs as normal maps; lattice as alpha-cutout; star lantern as emissive faceted mesh.
Sheet B: pavilions, temples, ruins, statues and fountains. Notes per item in monuments.md.
